method: Bounded local source reading, comparison with the pinned AI reader and historical probe API usage, byte fingerprints, and AST parsing without importing or executing the subject or reference modules.

closed_findings.title: Prepare-stage exceptions after run allocation were outside the evidence-saving try/finally
closed_findings.problem: write_frozen/save/initial output inspection and serializer/guard construction could raise after the new run directory existed but before the try. main would print HELD, without the per-run result or after-snapshot attempt.
closed_findings.fix: The reviewed revision initializes result immediately after allocating the run and puts every prepare-stage write/check plus guard/serialize construction inside the same try/finally as ops.run. The unified result-save path follows that block.
closed_findings.verification: Static control-flow reinspection only; no injected failure or runtime test was executed by this reviewer.

checks.detail: load_original pins the full 11273-byte Geometry source to AJ, requires byte equality in publication, and checks the exact original three imports. The proof body is neither edited nor extracted.

The local reader matches 36541 bytes / 0c6307af83c197123bd2da678bfd4ac6b76916169d6d457f83733461725b8272. The adapter pins git(AI), the original executed-reader file and publication copy before ModuleType exec, then calls base.load(AI, raw). It does not call base.worker or main.

snapshot calls the pinned base.check path. Its source path was read through prepare_base/new_spec/read_installation/new_owner_state/accepted_public/read_completed_run. It reads existing normal/kernel/stock receipts; no c.ag.ops.run occurs on that check path. New-probe validation requires normal_or_kernel_commands_executed=0 for this inherited read and the exact AI audit/source/run identities.

scope requires the original AG 360-node project graph, Geometry absent from that graph, the exact 141-dependency closure contained in the original 144-node AG active scope, and empty intersection with unaccepted_p3_dependencies. These counts agree with the earlier independent Geometry source review.

Exactly one subject ops.run call is present. It receives c.ag.h.serialize(0, lane, c.ag.h.guard(0, [lake,--no-build,env,lean,whole_probe_path])), cwd=PROJECT, relay=False. No -o, lake build, source installer, old worker, or kernel audit is invoked by the new subject.

The initial and final snapshots inspect Geometry canonical source (absent or exact same bytes), all 21 canonical artifact slots (all absent), and any Geometry acceptance-owner history under the old evidence root (none). Probe-adjacent 21 object suffixes must remain absent; ops diagnostics must show no built or failed project modules.

The inherited AI check retains old AG/AE source/artifact/context/runtime/evidence requirements. The new snapshot additionally hashes complete AI evidence and source-installation trees, and preserves Git plus Geometry slot/history. The final snapshot must equal the initial snapshot; detected drift is a failure and is not repaired or hidden.

After a run directory exists, prepare/dispatch/log/output failures now enter probe_error and still attempt after-snapshot/save. Preservation failures enter preservation_error. Success requires exit 0, completed command, preservation_passed, and neither error. Before run allocation, invalid input/preflight is fail-closed as GEOMETRY_PROBE_HELD on stdout; it does not claim a saved per-run result.
A nonempty existing publication/runs directory is rejected before allocating another attempt. Existing Geometry artifact/history also blocks the probe rather than causing recompilation.

normal_or_kernel_acceptance_claimed, new_owner_accepted, and whole_P1_5_complete are initialized False and are never changed to True. probe_passed only denotes the no-output probe result. The nested True acceptance fields remain explicitly scoped to original AI TrimLog evidence.
Python ast.parse succeeded without executing the source, importing its dynamically loaded readers, or creating bytecode.

limitations: No runtime/typecheck success is asserted. The original runtime helpers remain pinned and reused; this review did not rerun their old tests.
Unexpected filesystem failure can still prevent writing a result file; the code reports ordinary caught failures when the run directory remains writable.
Any further subject edit requires matching this recorded source identity or a bounded delta review.
recommendation: The reviewed exact bytes are ready for the parent-owned boundary tests and, when an authorized compiler endpoint is available, one original guarded whole-module no-output probe. Formal acceptance remains a separate later action.
